coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting nine ground-truth items (three constants, two model levels, one prompt setting, and three metrics), the output matches six: RepoBench Python at the dataset level, GPT-2, CodeLlama-7b, cross_file_first, EM, and ES.
coverage.design_error_analysis: CodeBLEU is omitted. The prescribed run.py/eval.py and construct_prompt/utils evaluation procedure is replaced with a custom pipeline. Execution parameters are not consistently controlled: temperature varies in sensitivity analyses and prompt token budgets differ by model. The dataset description also omits fixed date filtering and level categorization. Additional model and prompt variants go beyond the specified comparison.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected cross-model performance comparison.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion compares EM, ES, and CodeBLEU between the models or discusses the effects of model size and specialization on repository-level code completion.
